actions.title: Add or complete structured data
actions.problem: Organization/offer structured data is missing or incomplete.
actions.recommendation: Add valid Organization + Service/Product JSON-LD with core fields.
actions.how_to_verify: Re-scan: Organization and Service/Product markup are detected.

actions.title: Add concrete quantified information
actions.problem: Pages lack specific figures where they would support the topic.
actions.recommendation: Add concrete prices, percentages, specifications, measurements, counts or outcome figures where they genuinely support the page.
actions.expected_signal: Higher quantified-information density on relevant pages.

actions.title: Attribute claims to identifiable sources
actions.problem: Externally verifiable claims are not attributed to sources.
actions.recommendation: Attribute important externally verifiable claims to identifiable sources and link the supporting material where appropriate.
actions.expected_signal: Higher evidence attribution from named/linked sources.

actions.title: Present content in extractable structures
actions.problem: Specifications, comparisons and processes are not in extractable structures.
actions.recommendation: Present genuine specifications, comparisons and processes using semantic tables, lists or definition structures where they fit.
actions.expected_signal: Higher semantic extractability from real structures.

actions.title: Add concise direct answers
actions.problem: High-priority questions lack concise, extractable answers.
actions.recommendation: Add concise answer passages for high-priority customer questions. A dedicated FAQ page is not required.
actions.expected_signal: More direct-answer blocks for common questions.

actions.title: Add trust and transparency evidence
actions.problem: Trust signals (identity, references, policies) are thin.
actions.recommendation: Add about, contact/imprint, references/case studies, and policy pages.
actions.how_to_verify: Re-scan: transparency and reference signals are detected.

actions.title: Clarify business identity
actions.problem: The site's business identity is ambiguous or under-specified.
actions.recommendation: State a single, consistent organization identity (brand name, legal name, imprint/contact) and add Organization structured data.
actions.expected_signal: Higher Entity Clarity and an unambiguous brand across pages.
actions.how_to_verify: Re-scan: Entity Clarity rises and the brand no longer needs confirmation.

actions.title: Add accurate freshness metadata
actions.problem: Time-sensitive content lacks accurate publication/update metadata.
actions.recommendation: Add accurate publication/update metadata and visibly maintain time-sensitive content. Never change timestamps merely to look fresh.
actions.expected_signal: Valid, recent dates on freshness-relevant pages.

actions.title: Serve meaningful content without JS
actions.problem: Little meaningful content is present in server-rendered HTML.
actions.recommendation: Ensure core content is in the server-rendered HTML, not JS-only.
actions.expected_signal: Higher Technical Accessibility for server-visible content.
actions.how_to_verify: Re-scan: server-rendered pages expose meaningful text.

actions.title: Add dedicated service/product pages
actions.problem: Services are named but lack dedicated, detailed landing pages.
actions.recommendation: Give each primary service its own page with specific, factual detail.
actions.expected_signal: Higher Offer Clarity and stronger per-service evidence depth.
actions.how_to_verify: Re-scan: dedicated service/product pages are detected for each service.

disclaimer: This audit measures deterministic website readiness for retrieval, citation and answer extraction using research-supported and heuristic proxies. It does not measure or guarantee rankings, citations, traffic or visibility in ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity or other AI platforms.

stages.name: Retrieval Readiness
stages.explanation: Measures whether important pages are technically accessible, clearly associated with the business and aligned with likely information needs.

stages.name: Citation Readiness
stages.explanation: Measures whether relevant pages contain specific, attributable and trustworthy evidence suitable for use as a source.

stages.name: Answer Extractability
stages.explanation: Measures whether important information is presented in forms that can be cleanly extracted into answers, such as concise explanations, specifications, comparisons and procedures.

diagnostics.explanation: Offer Clarity is primarily limited by differentiating_factual_detail.
Sourceability is primarily limited by specific quantified information, source attribution.
